The prosecution says should be charged with "窝藏罪" (hiding a criminal). In lexicon, there is "窝藏、包庇". Also there is "包庇毒品犯罪分子" but not relevant. So the appropriate charge is "窝藏、包庇". The fact includes giving money to help escape, which could be "帮助犯罪分子逃跑"? Not in list. The list includes "窝藏、包庇". So we choose that.

Check if any other charges apply: "容留他人吸毒" no. "容留" is only for drug. "容留" not relevant. "引诱、容留、介绍卖淫" no. "提供侵入、非法控制计算机信息系统程序、工具" no. "妨害公务" no. "拒不执行判决、裁定" no. "拒不支付劳动报酬" no. So only "窝藏、包庇".
